definitions.gloss: old model; old type; outdated version
definitions.explanation: A previous version or model of a product, machine, or system that has been replaced by a newer one. Commonly used for electronics, vehicles, and equipment.

examples.japanese: これは{旧型|きゅうがた}のモデルだ。
{旧型|きゅうがた}のスマホはバッテリーの{持|も}ちが{悪|わる}い。
examples.english: Old model smartphones have poor battery life.

examples.japanese: {旧型|きゅうがた}の{機器|きき}を{新型|しんがた}に{入|い}れ{替|か}える{計画|けいかく}が{進|すす}んでいる。
examples.english: Plans to replace old equipment with new models are underway.

notes:
USAGE:
A compound of {旧|きゅう} (old, former) + {型|がた} (model, type). Often used as a noun modifier with の: {旧型|きゅうがた}の～. The opposite is {新型|しんがた} (new model).

COMMON COLLOCATIONS:
- {旧型|きゅうがた}の{車|くるま} (an old model car)
- {旧型|きゅうがた}から{新型|しんがた}に{買|か}い{替|か}える (to upgrade from the old model to the new model)

SIMILAR WORDS:
- {新型|しんがた}: new model — the antonym
- {型落|かたお}ち: discontinued model — specifically a model no longer in production, often sold at a discount
